preset.name: SF tech culture
preset.tagline: The most-talked-about tech, AI, and startup posts
preset.description: What everyone working at a startup is talking about this week: big AI launches, raises and acquisitions, viral builds, founder and VC takes, and the SF scene. Not deep engineering, not GTM or marketing.

focus.audience: people working at startups in San Francisco who want to know what tech Twitter is talking about
care_about: The biggest conversations in tech and AI this week: the posts everyone in tech is sharing and arguing about
AI model and product launches people are excited about or debating, from big labs and startups
Big startup and AI company moments: major raises and valuations, revenue and ARR milestones, acquisitions, notable hires and departures
Creative or delightful things people built with AI that are going viral, and how people are actually using AI at work
Founder, VC, and Y Combinator culture: founder stories, investor takes, demo days, and debates about how startups should run
San Francisco and Bay Area tech culture: events, parties, hackathons, and life in the scene
skip: Sales, GTM, and marketing tactics and tools: outbound, sales playbooks, campaigns, and posts from sales and marketing software companies
Deep technical engineering: papers, benchmark details, code, infrastructure, and developer tooling internals
Infrastructure and finance: data centers, chips, compute deals, earnings, stock moves
Crypto token shilling, giveaways, and generic motivational threads

topics.label: Launches
topics.description: New AI models and AI or tech product launches, from big labs or startups, that people are excited about or arguing over

topics.label: Startup business

topics.description: Creative or delightful things people built with AI that are going viral: demos, games, art, vibe-coded apps, clever prompts

topics.label: AI at work
topics.description: How people and teams actually use AI at work and in life, and big-picture takes on where it's going

topics.label: Founders & VC
topics.description: Founder stories, investor takes, Y Combinator and accelerators, demo days, and debates about how venture works

topics.label: SF scene
topics.description: San Francisco and Bay Area tech culture, events, parties, hackathons, and life

topics.label: Work culture
topics.description: Debates about how tech and startups work: hours, in-person vs remote, hiring, compensation, layoffs, and burnout

topics.label: GTM & marketing
topics.description: Sales, GTM, and marketing: playbooks, outbound, campaigns, positioning, and what sales and marketing tools are shipping

topics.description: Technical deep dives for engineers: papers, benchmark details, code, infrastructure, and developer tooling internals

topics.description: Infrastructure and markets: data centers, compute buildout, chips, power, public-company earnings, stock moves, macro
